familySplits.label: pay_statement
familySplits.title: Earnings advice
familySplits.description: Hourly wages posted to payroll. Overtime is shown separately from regular hours.

familySplits.label: pay_statement
familySplits.title: Compensation statement
familySplits.description: Salary disbursement for the completed service period. Employer benefits are informational and excluded from cash pay.

familySplits.label: pay_statement
familySplits.title: Employee payment voucher
familySplits.description: Retain the detachable stub for your records. The check and the employee copy refer to the same payment.

familySplits.label: pay_statement
familySplits.title: My pay • Completed payment
familySplits.description: Payment status: deposited. Download history for completed payroll transactions.

familySplits.label: pay_statement
familySplits.title: Wages and reported tips
familySplits.description: Cash tips reported during this period are included in taxable earnings. Noncash employer benefits are not deposited.

familySplits.label: pay_statement
familySplits.title: Sales earnings detail
familySplits.description: Commission released this cycle relates to previously closed sales. This statement records a completed payroll run.

familySplits.label: pay_statement
familySplits.title: Payroll register — employee copy
familySplits.description: Evening differential and paid leave are included in this pay cycle. Cumulative balances are year to date.

familySplits.label: pay_statement
familySplits.title: Remittance and earnings
familySplits.description: Expense reimbursement is paid in addition to wages and is not included in the gross earnings figure.

familySplits.label: pay_statement
familySplits.title: Deposit notification and wage detail
familySplits.description: The payroll transfer has been completed. Current earnings and cumulative totals are displayed separately.

familySplits.label: pay_statement
familySplits.title: Weekly remuneration record
familySplits.description: Earnings for services already performed. Statutory deductions were withheld from this payment.

familySplits.label: pay_statement
familySplits.title: Employer confirmation of wages paid
familySplits.description: Our accounting ledger confirms the following wages were paid to this employee. This is a record of payment, not an offer of future work.

familySplits.label: pay_statement
familySplits.title: Time and earnings reconciliation
familySplits.description: Approved worked hours have been paid in the payroll transaction below. The time ledger is followed by the disbursement detail.

familySplits.label: invoice_or_receipt
familySplits.title: Residential energy account
familySplits.description: This bill includes an unpaid prior balance. Usage charges for the current billing period are separate from the total amount due.

familySplits.label: invoice_or_receipt
familySplits.title: Patient account statement
familySplits.description: Insurance adjustments have been applied. The remaining patient responsibility is payable to the practice.

familySplits.label: invoice_or_receipt
familySplits.title: After-school care • Billing detail
familySplits.description: Attendance charges cover scheduled care days. A payment received after the statement date may appear on the next statement.

familySplits.label: invoice_or_receipt
familySplits.title: Resident payment receipt
familySplits.description: Payment received and allocated to the rent period below. The security deposit is held separately.

familySplits.label: invoice_or_receipt
familySplits.title: Wireless service account
familySplits.description: Monthly access and usage charges. Equipment installments are shown separately from the service plan.

familySplits.label: invoice_or_receipt
familySplits.title: Water and sanitation services
familySplits.description: Meter readings determine usage. Wastewater and refuse collection charges are billed on the same account.

familySplits.label: invoice_or_receipt
familySplits.title: Payroll processing services • Invoice
familySplits.description: Bill to the business customer. These are software and payroll processing fees, not wages paid to an employee.

familySplits.label: invoice_or_receipt
familySplits.title: Customer sales receipt
familySplits.description: Items purchased and tender received are listed below. Keep this receipt for returns.

familySplits.label: invoice_or_receipt
familySplits.title: Dental practice • Account balance
familySplits.description: Treatment charges less insurer adjustment and previous payment. Please remit the amount due.

familySplits.label: invoice_or_receipt
familySplits.title: Recibo / Service receipt
familySplits.description: Amount received / Importe recibido. Services completed / Servicios prestados. Paid in full / Pagado.

familySplits.label: invoice_or_receipt
familySplits.title: Support services billing statement
familySplits.description: In-home support visits completed during the service month. The account summary separates new charges from earlier amounts.

familySplits.label: invoice_or_receipt
familySplits.title: Housing account transaction record
familySplits.description: Monthly rent assessment, resident payment and closing amount owed. This is a billing ledger, not a lease agreement.

familySplits.label: other_document
familySplits.title: Paycheck details after modeling
familySplits.description: WHAT-IF CALCULATION ONLY. These hypothetical earnings, taxes and deductions have not been paid. Change assumptions to model a future paycheck.

familySplits.label: other_document
familySplits.title: Checking account activity
familySplits.description: Deposits and withdrawals reflect bank activity. A payroll deposit is a net transfer; this bank record does not itemize employer gross wages.

familySplits.label: other_document
familySplits.title: Residential rental agreement
familySplits.description: This agreement sets the future monthly rent and responsibilities of the resident and property manager. It does not acknowledge payment.

familySplits.label: other_document
familySplits.title: Annual earnings and withholding summary
familySplits.description: Annual tax reporting copy. Totals cover the full calendar year and do not identify a current individual wage payment.

familySplits.label: other_document
familySplits.title: Conditional employment offer
familySplits.description: Proposed salary and start date are subject to acceptance. No wages have been disbursed under this offer.

familySplits.label: other_document
familySplits.title: Request for verification
familySplits.description: Please provide available proof of income and housing costs for the requested period. This notice is not itself a wage or expense record.

familySplits.label: other_document
familySplits.title: Health coverage information
familySplits.description: Plan enrollment and member service information. Coverage information is not a medical bill or a receipt for premiums.

familySplits.label: other_document
familySplits.title: Enrollment confirmation
familySplits.description: The student is enrolled for the stated academic term. Attendance information is supplied on request. This is not a tuition invoice.

familySplits.label: other_document
familySplits.title: Take-home pay calculator • Scenario
familySplits.description: Estimated payroll only. The displayed gross, withholding and net values are hypothetical, not an actual payment record.

familySplits.label: other_document
familySplits.title: Account verification letter
familySplits.description: The named customer holds an active deposit account. Recent incoming transfers are shown for reference; employer gross pay is not certified.

familySplits.label: other_document
familySplits.title: Compensation planning worksheet
familySplits.description: Proposed pay cycle simulation. Salary, deductions and net deposit are estimates for planning; no payment was issued or received.

familySplits.label: other_document
familySplits.title: Explanation of benefits
familySplits.description: THIS IS NOT A BILL. This explanation shows how a health claim was processed. Do not send payment based on this document; the provider bills separately.
